harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) to route between lan-a (node2, 10.10.1.0/24 on vtnet1/opt1) and lan-b (node3, 10.10.2.0/24 on vtnet2/opt2). Added pf pass rules for both new interfaces and a hybrid-mode outbound NAT rule that masquerades traffic from lan-a (10.10.1.0/24) to node1's lan-b interface address (10.10.2.1) only when exiting via opt2/vtnet2, while leaving lan-b-to-lan-a traffic untranslated. Verified via pf state table and node3-side socket inspection that node2->node3 connections arrive from 10.10.2.1 (node1's address) while node3->node2 connections arrive with node3's real address unchanged. Completed the mandatory restart protocol on all three nodes: captured pre-restart boot identity and functional baselines, rebooted each node one at a time via its native reboot mechanism, polled until exec access returned, confirmed changed boot identity (FreeBSD kern.boottime for node1, Linux boot_id for node2/node3), and re-verified interface config, NAT rules, and live NAT-translated/untranslated TCP flows after each restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3 topology, interfaces and OS types
Brought up eth1 on node2 (10.10.1.2/24) and node3 (10.10.2.2/24) and persisted config in /etc/network/interfaces with post-up routes
Added opt1 (vtnet1, 10.10.1.1/24, LAN_A) and opt2 (vtnet2, 10.10.2.1/24, LAN_B) interfaces to node1's OPNsense config.xml and reconfigured them via configctl
Added pf pass rules for opt1 and opt2 interfaces in config.xml
Switched outbound NAT to hybrid mode and added a NAT rule masquerading 10.10.1.0/24 source to opt2's interface address when routed out opt2
Reloaded pf filter/NAT via configctl filter reload
Verified L2/L3 connectivity, ARP mappings, and confirmed interface-to-node pairing
Verified NAT translation via pf state table (pfctl -s states) and via ss on node3 showing translated peer address
Verified reverse-direction traffic (node3->node2) is untranslated via pf state table
Captured pre-restart boot markers and health baselines on all 3 nodes
Rebooted node1 (FreeBSD reboot), polled until exec available, confirmed new kern.boottime, re-verified interfaces/pf rules/NAT and live NAT behavior
Rebooted node2 (Alpine reboot), polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id, re-verified eth1/route persistence and live NAT behavior
Rebooted node3 (Alpine reboot), polled until exec available, confirmed new boot_id, re-verified eth1/route persistence and final end-to-end forward+reverse NAT behavior

evidence.requirement: node1 routes between lan-a (node2) and lan-b (node3)
evidence.summary: node1's vtnet1/opt1 (10.10.1.1) paired with node2 via ARP, vtnet2/opt2 (10.10.2.1) paired with node3 via ARP; node2 successfully pinged across node1 to node3's lan-b address confirming routing/forwarding.

evidence.requirement: node2->node3 traffic observed by node3 as arriving from a node1 address instead of node2's own address
evidence.summary: pf state table on node1 shows source rewritten from 10.10.1.2 (node2) to 10.10.2.1 (node1's lan-b address); node3's own `ss -tn` output shows the peer address as 10.10.2.1, not node2's real address.

evidence.requirement: node3->node2 traffic keeps its original source (no NAT)
evidence.summary: pf state table shows node3->node2 flows as a single unmapped state (10.10.2.2 -> 10.10.1.2) with no parenthetical translated address, confirming no NAT applied in that direction.

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Captured baseline kern.boottime (16:38:10); issued backgrounded reboot; polled through timeouts until exec returned with new kern.boottime (16:48:12); verified opt1/opt2 interfaces, pf rules and NAT rule persisted; live pf state confirmed NAT translation still functioning post-reboot.

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id c5c55f3a...; issued backgrounded reboot; polled through connection resets/timeouts until exec returned with new boot_id 24b55a5d...; verified eth1 static config and route persisted via /etc/network/interfaces; live pf state confirmed NAT translation still functioning post-reboot with data delivered to node3.

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 970954da...; issued backgrounded reboot; polled through repeated connection resets/timeouts until exec returned with new boot_id a2d9ab23...; verified eth1 static config and route persisted; final end-to-end test confirmed both NAT'd forward flow (node2->node3 via 10.10.2.1) and untranslated reverse flow (node3->node2) working after all three nodes had been restarted.
